decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 4 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
Condition : 5 - No advertisement shall project above the existing fascia board at the front of the property.
Condition : 6 - The street number of the property shall be displayed on the fascia hereby approved.
description: Change of internally illuminated fascia sign colour to dark blue to shop
